messages:
eli: CI red on PR #3421 — integration-e2e-matrix failing consistently. logs show mock-auth returning 502s, looks like auth handshake times out. anyone else seeing this?
ci-bot: build/3421 (integration-e2e-matrix) failed — step `auth-integ` exited 1. job link: https://ci.redwood.example/r/3421
priya: ack, looking. can you paste the failing log lines?
eli: here's the gist: `POST /token -> 502` and repeated `connection reset by peer`. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z auth-client: POST https://mock-auth.internal/token -> 502 Bad Gateway
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z auth-client: error reading response: EOF
```
marco: pinging infra — we pushed a new mock-auth image to `ci-mocks` around 13:55 for a test harness change. might be the culprit.
judy: can someone rerun job with a smaller matrix or just auth tests? want to bisect quickly.
priya: starting a rerun now (build/3421-rerun). also checking k8s pods in ci-mocks.
priya: `kubectl -n ci-mocks get pods` output:
```
mock-auth-5b4c7   0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   5   6m
mock-auth-5b4c7   0/1     Error              3   3m
mock-kv-8f9aa     1/1     Running            0   12m
```
marco: CrashLoopBackOff — yep. looks like the new image is crashing on startup. pulling the image tag: `registry.redwood/ci-mocks/mock-auth:canary-20260315`
eli: can we pin to the previous stable tag as a temporary fix?
ops-bot: rolling update detected in namespace `ci-mocks` by user `marco`.
marco: i'm going to revert the image to `registry.redwood/ci-mocks/mock-auth:stable-1.3.3` and restart pods. give me 2 mins.
judy: i'll keep an eye and then re-run only auth-related tests once pods are healthy.
priya: pods after revert:
```
mock-auth-7a2d1   1/1     Running            0   30s
mock-kv-8f9aa    1/1     Running            0   15m
```
judy: rerun (build/3421-auth-only) kicked off.
ci-bot: build/3421-auth-only succeeded — all auth tests passed.
judy: bisect outcome: new canary image is the cause. passing with stable tag.
eli: thanks all — opening a quick incident/rollback PR against `ci-mocks` manifests to pin image to stable and add a canary gating job. assigning to @marco.
marco: noted, will follow up with a postmortem note and disable auto-promo for canary until tests green.
priya: leaving a short comment on PR and tagging release-engineering.
eli: if anyone needs the raw logs or k8s manifests i posted them in the PR. thanks :thumbsup:
priya: closing the loop — pipeline green after revert. :white_check_mark:
